definition: When the ta of a feminine noun is written open, a stop on the word is with the ta, not a ha. The book names 14 words at their places (13 are matched): رحمت، نعمت، بنعمت، امرأت (before زوج), سنت، لعنت، معصيت، بقيت، قرت، فطرت، شجرت، جنت، ابنت (and كلمت in al-A'raf 137).
limitations: Only the longer book Nabhan is cited; Book A does not have this topic.
Paraphrase of the cited pages by an automated drafter; not scholarly reviewed.
A closed list in the Kufian numbering used by the book.
The corpus writes كلمة with a closed ta in al-A'raf 137, where the book names an open ta, so that place is not matched.
The engine stops only at the end of an ayah, so the note says what stopping on the word gives.

conditions.description: The word is one of the named words at its named place.
